items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Terminology 38:1
items.html: A minute illumination, which does not suffice to give relief but only suffices to sustain the form of the vessel upon its base — this illumination is called “to enliven the vessel.” (Part 4, Chapter 2, Item 8)
